note: Parts from JIG_ that remove soldering, crimping and breadboards from a build. Links go to jig-robotics.com.

parts.name: JIG_ wire connectors
parts.summary: Turns a handful of loose female jumper wires into one plug that pushes onto a board's pin header. No soldering, crimping or special tools.
parts.use_when: Required default for compatible board-to-board installed, unshrouded, single-row 2.54 mm male headers, subject to exact model and all fit/electrical checks.

sizes.small: for single-pin jumper housings about 12 x 2 x 2 mm
sizes.large: for single-pin jumper housings about 14 x 2.5 x 2.5 mm

parts.rule: Use one connector per header row, with the same pin count as the WHOLE row, even if only some pins are wired. A shorter connector will not fit beside the unused pins.
parts.packs: 1-8 pins come in packs of 5; 22 pins and 9-21 pins come in pairs; an assortment has 2 each of 1-8 plus one 22-pin.

parts.name: JIG_ battery adapter for Seeed Studio XIAO
parts.summary: Candidate adapter for adding a battery to a XIAO board; R29 is untested and must not be recommended as a qualified battery/current path.
parts.use_when: A XIAO ESP32 build that should run on a battery.
parts.fits: Two 7-pin header rows at 2.54 mm. Check the exact XIAO model and battery connector.

parts.name: Agent Meter kit
parts.summary: A small desk character that shows what your AI coding agent is doing and how much of your Codex or Claude allowance is left. Everything plugs together; firmware comes preloaded.
parts.use_when: As a complete reference build, or for anyone who wants a status display for their coding agent.
